paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets, with each segment representing a specific source and its corresponding percentage contribution. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to NQ, accounting for 31.3% of the data. The second largest is FEVER, shown in teal, at 16.1%. Other notable contributors include MULTIFC (11.3%, light teal), SNLI (15.4%, orange), and VITAMINC (13.0%, light blue). Smaller segments include MULTINLI (11.3%, red), SCITAIL (1.2%, green), and PUBHEALTH (0.5%, very light green). The smallest contributors are SCIFACT (0.1%, yellow), ENTFA (1.8%, dark green), FACTCC (2.6%, dark orange), and ANLI (4.6%, dark red). The chart includes a legend with labels and percentages, with each slice connected by a line to its respective label, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top.
